bundlingNotes: Section 1 Introduction states explicitly: 'The rates shown are the all-inclusive title insurance fees and charges and includes both the risk portion and the service or work portion, but does not include charges for title search, surveys, escrow, closing services, settlement services, recording fees, other charges, or other monies advanced on behalf of an applicant.' A companion WFG informational bulletin (KY 2020-01, Oct. 14, 2020) confirms Kentucky's municipal premium tax (varying by county/municipality per the KY Dept. of Revenue's annual tax schedule) applies to the title premium, to endorsements, AND to Closing Protection Letters -- but the bulletin itself prices no settlement/escrow fees, only pointing to the premium-tax schedule. WFG's CPL is a flat $50 per party regardless of role, unlike Stewart's tiered $50/$25/$25 lender/buyer/seller structure -- a genuine cross-underwriter difference in this ancillary charge.
